paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
notes: Paper sets new limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (and g_aBB hypercharge coupling) from LEP Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma data, plus LHC/FCC-ee projections. The coupling type is AxionPhoton. However, numerical limit values are only presented graphically in Fig. 4 (log-log plots, ma in eV, g in GeV^-1) and not in any extractable table of (mass, coupling) pairs. Table 1 contains signal/background cross sections, not exclusion limits. The exclusion is roughly MeV-90 GeV (1e6 to ~9e10 eV) with couplings around 10^-3 to 10^-4 GeV^-1, but precise points cannot be reliably digitized from text. Both observed limits (LEP) and projections (LHC, FCC-ee) are present. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 4(a) shows new LEP limits (green region enclosed by dashed Z→2γ and solid Z→3γ lines) on ALP-photon coupling. The y-axis is Log10(g_aγγ[GeV^-1]) from -12 to 0, x-axis Log10(m_a[eV]) from ~-15 to 13. The new LEP green region covers MeV (~10^5 eV) to ~90 GeV (~9.1e10 eV) at couplings around 3e-5 to 1e-4 GeV^-1. Boundary traced is the lower edge of the new green LEP exclusion island. Note: panel (a) is hypercharge coupling; values approximate due to dense overlapping regions and log-axis reading.
